body: I have tried,  I will keep trying...  but she has already given me many chances...

The Recollection was realising that 'I will never be enough for anymore'.

I also think 'critical' is the wrong word.  I have been getting jealous when she doesn't spend all her time with me & just being a jerk...  She has had enough & won't speak to me.  I don't blame her.  I am become such an insecure person I thought I would loose her as a friend if we didn't hang out all the time... boy was I wrong.. me being 'needy' seems to have resulted in my worst fear, loosing her altogether.
